question: Q2
source_derivation: Distance regression and error structure associated with Fig. 6. The solver defines and validates unusual-environment regimes.
illustrative_analysis: Fit distance regressors, define short/middle/long regimes using training-distance quantiles, and compare signed errors and MAE with a training-median baseline, including material-bootstrap intervals.
illustrative_design: Audit provenance/label coverage; use available-ID material groups with two approximately 60/20/20 train/validation/test holdouts; train ExtraTrees with 80 trees and validation-selected leaf size 1 or 5. Report conditional group-bootstrap intervals, training-only baselines and source-selection limits. These are example choices only.
executed_finding: Descriptive mean over eight elements and two holdouts: short: mean MAE 0.0307 Å, mean bias +0.0293 Å; middle: mean MAE 0.0169 Å, mean bias +0.0033 Å; long: mean MAE 0.0674 Å, mean bias -0.0520 Å. Full regime support and uncertainty are in the example, not universal calibration targets.
solver_input_boundary: Only the standalone prompt and eight input files. Evaluator materials and the review site must be inaccessible during a benchmark attempt.

commands.purpose: Execute one worked research design; its choices are examples, not solver requirements.
